name: Tsurupeta★Hanyaan
source:
Protagonist, Akinose Souji, is the son of the head of the world-renowned Akinose Group, a wealthy tycoon. But one day, his life becomes unexpectedly lively when twin witches, Ririka and Erika, along with a maid and an android from the group's staffing service, arrive at his home. All of his new housemates are cute girls. They are cheerful, innocent, and smile at him with pure, untainted eyes. Gradually climbing the stairs to adulthood, the girls' dazzlingly candid figures. A sweet daily life awaits with these girls who seem to bring about a blissful pleasure in front of you!

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=25441]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主人公秋之濑总司是世界知名财阀秋之濑集团掌门人的儿子。然而有一天，双胞胎魔女莉莉卡和绘里香，以及集团人才服务部门派来的一名女仆和一台仿生人一同住进他家，让他的生活突然热闹起来。新来的同住者全都是可爱的少女。她们开朗、纯真，用毫无杂质的眼神对他微笑。少女们逐渐迈上通往成人世界的阶梯，那率真无邪的身影耀眼夺目。仿佛能将幸福与欢愉带到眼前的她们，将与你共度甜蜜的日常！

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=25441]Getchu[/url]]
